subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw own an opt-in Open WebUI visible-history sync/backfill path for Control UI turns, and if so should that path use a supported Open WebUI API/extension point or direct external DB updates?
rationale: The remaining work crosses a third-party persistent store and likely needs operator configuration, schema-version handling, security posture, and historical repair policy; source inspection can confirm the gap but cannot choose that product boundary.

options.title: Define opt-in sync contract
options.body: Approve a bounded Open WebUI sync design first, then implement runtime mirroring plus live Docker proof and a separate historical repair story.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Close or narrow the request by documenting that OpenClaw supports Open WebUI as an OpenAI-compatible frontend but does not update Open WebUI's own visible history from Control UI turns.

options.title: Wait for adjacent session work
options.body: Keep this issue open until the linked session-identity PRs resolve, then re-check whether a narrower visible-history fix remains.

recommendation.title: Define opt-in sync contract
recommendation.body: Approve a bounded Open WebUI sync design first, then implement runtime mirroring plus live Docker proof and a separate historical repair story.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across the Gateway chat/session/control UI surfaces and is the best available routing candidate for the product-boundary call.
